c1.basis: 32 FP32 eps in normalized units is a diagnostic budget, not a theorem for the network. Metric budget 0.001 is one tenth of baseline's reported 0.01 resolution, fixed before new metric comparisons. Prior numeric failures are known, so this is a prospective conditional continuation gate, NOT retrospective proof of equivalence or global scientific equivalence.
c1.decision: All identity/finite/target checks plus numerical scale budget and metric budget on every selected window at 15/30/60 minutes permit C1_CONDITIONAL_PASS only. Original numeric mismatch remains recorded.

cache.resume: verify shard checksum, indices, finite and protocol/source fingerprint before reuse

head.architecture: shared per-node Linear(28,width),ReLU,Linear(width,12); last layer zero initialized
head.loss: unmasked mean absolute error original Flow
head.selection: minimum validation interior MAE across all 12 horizons; tie configuration order

validation_selection: Keep all split indices; score only labels > last training label and < first test label; excludes shared labels without rewriting split. Full validation metrics also reported.

xai.scope: residual head cached features; baseline prediction in additive skip remains fixed; NOT attribution of raw LSTTN system
xai.sample_rule: 16 evenly spaced test positions before viewing test errors
xai.outputs: all 170 sensors and all 12 horizons; report 3/6/12 steps
xai.ig: optional; omit if delaying required occlusion
